utterances.text: What's your favorite childhood meal? Mine is lawia. It's this delicious stew filled with vegetables and actually some fruit. My grandma tells me it's the Paranaque recipe, which is the city I was born and raised in. When I went back home, this is what I requested. I just really love it. I figured it would be a good idea to learn how to make it myself. So I asked my grandma, can you show me how to make it? And so she did. Do you want to learn too?
